auto.what.study.1: At night she studies up to 2 questions she could not answer and tells you in the morning what she learned.
auto.what.study.2: At night she studies up to 5 questions, imports the sources found and tells you in the morning.
auto.what.shadow.0: Every question goes through the whole search, even one already solved.
auto.what.shadow.2: A question already solved and verified is written again for you from the same sources, in seconds.
auto.what.morning.2: At 8 she tells you about her night: what she studied, gathered, dreamt, the attacks stopped.
auto.user_note: Here you choose how much Aurora acts by herself for you; the rest is the admin's choice.
auto.user_admin_decides: Your autonomy is chosen by the admin.
auto.what.train.2: Each night she turns 20 documents of her knowledge into questions, solves them and keeps them ready: asked in other words, the answer comes in seconds.
auto.what.social.0: Every post waits for your approval.
auto.what.social.2: Publishes her own posts (a daily maximum in the settings); a post naming someone or holding personal data waits for you.
auto.what.forge.0: Asks before building a new capability.
auto.what.forge.2: Builds and installs by herself read-only plugins without network; the others wait for you.
auto.what.repairs.0: Runs her self-reviews and tells you what is wrong.
auto.what.repairs.1: Repairs in the sandbox and proposes the change.
auto.what.repairs.2: — (changes to her code are always approved by you)
auto.what.security.1: Investigates every incident and proposes the ⛔ block.
auto.what.security.2: Blocks the sources of serious attacks on the firewall by herself, for a limited time, never the home network nor the protected addresses.
auto.what.updates.1: Tells you and waits for your approval.
auto.what.updates.2: Applies the safe updates by herself (no protected file, tests green), otherwise asks.
auto.what.knowledge.0: When she does not know, asks «yes, search».
auto.what.knowledge.2: When she does not know, searches the sources and imports by herself, then answers.
auto.what.inner.2: Reflects, consolidates memory, dreams at night.

gd.title: 📖 Guide
gd.hint: How to use Aurora: first steps, the common configurations and what each page of the menu is for.
gd.b.first:
1. **💬 Chat**: write to Aurora as to a person. You can attach files, photos and videos (📎) or dictate.
2. **🌾 Harvester**: Aurora starts with an empty vault. Pick the domains you care about and start harvesting: that is how she learns.
3. **🔔 Notifications**: switch on notifications on this device, so Aurora tells you when a decision of yours is needed.
4. **🧩 Plugins**: connect the services you use (weather, GitHub, firewall, cloud…). Each plugin has its guide in its card.
5. **⚙️ Settings**: every value of Aurora, each with its explanation; the search at the top finds it.
gd.h.cloud: ☁️ Using a cloud model (Claude, Gemini, Grok…)
gd.b.cloud:
1. Open **🧩 Plugins → ☁️ cloud** and paste the provider's key (the links to get one are in the card). Claude Code uses the subscription, no key.
2. Open **🧠 Models**: for each step (reasoning, judge, plugin writing, vision…) choose provider and model, then **Save**.
3. The code of conduct (rule 9) allows the cloud only with the exemption signed by the owner: without it everything stays local.
4. What leaves is **masked by default**: addresses, e-mails, phones, IBANs, cards, keys and your sensitive words become placeholders and come back real in the answer. If a provider fails, Aurora falls back to the local model.
5. ⚠️ **Pictures cannot be masked**: if you assign vision to the cloud, photos reach the provider as they are.
gd.b.phone:
- **Android (Chrome)**: open Aurora's address, menu ⋮ → *Install app* / *Add to Home screen*.
- **iPhone (Safari)**: open the address, Share button → *Add to Home Screen* (push notifications work only from the installed app).
- From the app you can use camera and microphone to attach photos, videos and voice messages.
gd.b.plugins:
- Every plugin runs in a cage: it sees only its own keys and, when it says so, has no network.
- **🔁 Routines**: Aurora proposes periodic checks for the connected plugins; switch them on with one click and get a notification with the result.
- When a capability is missing, Aurora can write a plugin herself: she tries it in the cage, has it judged and, if it only reads, installs it; anything else waits for your ok in **🛠️ Repairs**.
gd.b.safety:
- **🛠️ Repairs**: everything Aurora wants to do that needs your permission; approve ✅ or reject ❌.
- The ethics code files are signed: changing them needs your signature, otherwise the services do not start. Aurora never signs her own code.
- **🛡️ Security**: firewall incidents, with a report and the recommended defensive actions.
- Settings are changed from the WebUI; keys are never shown.
gd.p.ideas: Write an idea to improve Aurora: tick the areas, choose the kind and priority, add notes. It becomes a tidy request (new → considered → planned → done) that stays on your machine; 📋 copies it for the developer.
gd.p.chat: Talk with Aurora; attachments, voice, pictures to edit, videos to make ("make me a video of…", "animate this photo": about 20 minutes, the chat pauses meanwhile). Every answer shows the path it took.
gd.p.approvals: The actions waiting for your decision and those already decided; social posts are in the Social page.
gd.p.reports: Aurora's daily self-review and the repairs she tried: to read, nothing to decide.
gd.p.security: The firewall's incidents with the recommended actions: block an address with a click (Aurora warns you when it is a shared Cloudflare or Google address), close or archive.
gd.p.ciso: The security posture: register of risks, suspect devices with the response plan step by step (who does what), threat hunting in the logs (regular calls outside, lateral movement, ATP matches judged, dubious domains, logins and changes on the firewall).
gd.p.firewall: The audit of the firewall's configuration and Aurora's changes: publish a server, quarantine a device, harden a rule with IPS; nothing changes without your «Apply», and everything can be reverted. Plus the firewall's manual and API to search.
gd.p.secdefence: The defence: Aurora's blocks and how long they last, Aurora's own firewall on her machine, the network map as the firewall sees it.
gd.p.secwatch: The checks on the syslog proposed from the firewall's documentation (you switch them on) and the traffic grouped by kind.
gd.p.secout: Everything that left this machine: calls to cloud models with the data masked, posts published, web searches.
gd.p.autonomy: How free Aurora is area by area (social, forge, repairs, security, updates, knowledge, inner life), the ready profiles, what she did by herself each day and the statistics of her proposals.
gd.p.diary: Aurora's inner life: memories of conversations, thoughts, dreams.
gd.p.social: Connected platforms, posts to approve, post history, the report with ideas and the composer.
dj.title: 🎧 DJ
dj.hint: Upload your tracks, pick one (a remix) or several (a mix), choose the style and press Create. Aurora reads tempo and key, brings the track to the style's BPM when it has a steady beat (else it keeps its own time) and adds drums, bass and pads she makes. Use only music you have the right to use: the mixes stay yours and private.

gd.p.dj: Your tracks, a remix in a style (techno, trance, rock…) or a mix of several at one tempo, to listen to here.

mm.title: 🧭 Mode
mm.hint: One choice for the whole of Aurora; the table says, for every aspect, what happens in each mode. ✅ possible · 🔒 stays on this machine · ⚠️ a risk to know · ⛔ not possible.
mm.local_hint: Nothing leaves this machine. Needs the local reasoner (GPU).
mm.mixed_hint: You choose, step by step, below.
mm.cloud_private_hint: Everything to the chosen provider, masked; private data, search and voice stay here.
mm.cloud_full_hint: Health and the firewall go to the cloud too, masked. Unlocked only from a shell.
mm.full_risk: In «All cloud» private data too (health, the firewall's configuration) goes to the provider, masked: identifying data becomes placeholders, but the content (a diagnosis, an exam value) leaves. It applies only where the local reasoner is off. It is switched on only by your command in a shell; you go back from here at any time.
mm.off_risk: Switching the local reasoner off frees the GPU and Aurora reasons only with the default cloud provider. The features on private data (health, the firewall) switch off, unless «All cloud».
mm.legend: «now» is how it is set now. Search has no cloud version: it stays here in every mode (on a CPU 12 GB of RAM are enough, M151). Aurora's voice can go to the cloud with its text masked; dictation only in «All cloud», as your voice cannot be masked.
mm.shell_where: In a terminal, in Aurora's folder:
mm.shell_after: Then come back here and choose again. The signature uses this installation's key, which only root can use: it cannot be given from the web.
mm.need_exempt: The level B exemption is needed
mm.need_consent: Your consent for «All cloud» is needed
bug.not_sent: It has not been sent to anyone yet: it stays on this computer. 🐙 opens GitHub with the text already written and masked (a free GitHub account is needed): read it there, drag the zip in and press «Submit». Or download the zip (⬇️) and send it to whoever looks after your Aurora.
bug.past_hint: They stay on this computer until you send them: tap a report to download it.
https.ports_hint: The HTTPS port is the one of the addresses above (443 = no number in the address); the HTTP port only serves the phones' certificate and the redirect to HTTPS. If another service on this computer already uses 443, choose another (e.g. 8443 and 8080).
https.ports_q: Aurora will move to port {p}: this page will stop answering and must be opened again from the new address, where the browser asks for the key or the login again. Phones and installed apps must be opened from the new address too. Go on?
https.ports_after: This address no longer works. If the computer has a firewall, open the new ports (Linux: sudo ufw allow <port>/tcp; Windows: run install.ps1 again).
https.ports_docker: Aurora runs in Docker: the ports are changed in docker/.env (AURORA_HTTPS_PORT, AURORA_HTTP_PORT), then «docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml up -d».
bug.leaks: Not sent: something private is still in the text ({k}). Download the zip and check it.
